subject: skill:diagram-design
gist: The brief before the diagram, and the one offer at the caps
reason: A brief of the question, form, nodes, finish, palette and reader precedes each diagram and is read into its manifest; the diagram is offered once per change at the caps, never as a remake.

authorisedBy.words: J-204 S1, on the operator's words of 2026-11-08, "you have my go, see this through release of 0.2.0" and "draft it the way you recommend and we fold this within 0.2.0 as well", fast with the review waived, under the register's row of 2026-11-08, "One offer per change at the caps": the picture decision a table in show-me's method that the block points at, one offer of a kept picture per change at the caps in one line the turn's end counts, never a lost picture's remake, and a brief before every durable picture, read into its manifest and shown on its card

ruling.words: The method items carry the operator's ruling of 2026-09-11 (series-s7-roster-2026-09-11), in the operator's words as review-contracts-2026-09-26 records them: "whatever the plan still owed be finished with the maintainer's recommendations"

the operator's rulings of 2026-10-04, "cool then lock everything in": every change in every mode has one record its steps write, which replaced the tickets' execution accounts, and a habit writes none of its own

R21 of 2026-10-08: a candidate bound to orchestration, a harness's mechanisms or subagent configuration is never taken as written; its portable form is taken ("greenline is supposed to work in any harness cli"), ruled with "yes go ahead"
J-59, on the operator's words of 2026-10-09 ('okay then implement all of this'): a gist of at most twelve words on every account whose reason is stated; no text, measure or method changes
